The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search for three different models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink. 2. The vertical axis represents the performance gain (+%) and is labeled as "Performance Gain (+%)". The horizontal axis lists the three models. 3. The bars are grouped by model, with each model having two bars representing "Strong Supervision" and "Weak Supervision". 4. The "Strong Supervision" bars are solid and the "Weak Supervision" bars are striped. 5. The performance gain for GPT-4o with strong supervision is approximately 25%, for weak supervision it is around 5%. 6. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the performance gain with strong supervision is about 10%, and with weak supervision, it is around 5%. 7. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the performance gain with strong supervision is approximately 15%, and with weak supervision, it is around 5%.
